reason: I have never heard of Nora Furnish and there is nothing here about reviews, Trustpilot or a track record, so I would be googling 'is norafurnish legit' before I put in a card. Even then, 10 to 12 business days for a light is slow when I am on a winter refresh schedule for two units.
objection: No reviews or track record that I can see, and a store I have never heard of wants $360 for a light that I cannot see in person, with return shipping on me if it looks different from the photos.
would_change_my_mind: A solid base of independent reviews (Trustpilot, photos from real buyers) and free returns or a clear quality guarantee, plus a firm delivery date I can plan around.
